risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 15 days compounds volatility risk for discretionary consumer sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with three white soldiers pattern provides short-term bullish momentum setup near support (67.42), and extreme market fear (VIX crisis) creates contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
